conclusion: NPA and ICB wire shapes are sufficiently identified for a version-pinned UEFI client prototype. This does not yet establish a safe persistent ADSP handoff: cold epoch and post-ExitBootServices power/ICC ownership are unresolved.

0x10.prototype: EFI_STATUS CreateSyncClientEx(const char *resource, const char *client_name, uint32_t client_type, uint32_t client_data_bytes, const void *client_data, void **handle)
0x10.note: No This argument. Provider writes core return to handle and returns EFI_SUCCESS even if handle is null.

0x90.prototype: EFI_STATUS IssueVector(void *handle, uint32_t word_count, const void *requests)
0x90.note: Provider invokes core RVA0x3620 then returns 0; EFI return is not an independently checked hardware status.

npa.icb_client_data: Consecutive pairs {uint32 master, uint32 slave}, eight bytes per route. CreateSyncClientEx client_data_bytes=8*route_count.
npa.icb_request: 32-byte record with aligned u64 fields per route: u32 type at +0; reserved/pad +4; u64 instantaneous bandwidth at +8; u64 average bandwidth at +16; optional latency/flags area +24. Type 4 selects direct bandwidth values. IssueVector word_count=8*route_count.
icb_evidence: PILProxyDxe RVA0x23c4-0x2424: type 0x400, size and vector count shifted by 3
PILProxyDxe RVA0x2090-0x20f0: request allocation stride32 and type field
ICBDxe RVA0x3268-0x336c: type4 copies +8/+16 to instantaneous/average result
ICBDxe RVA0x5618-0x5930: commits states and performs conditional wait; flags affect wait behavior

icb_protocol.methods: Only one method +8 (RVA0x13ec), invoking internal initialization/synchronization. Actual client arbitration uses NPA /icb/arbiter.

stock_uefi_proxy_configuration.warning: These are UEFI native configuration IDs/units, not Linux DT interconnect IDs. Android requests logical384 and UINT_MAX ICC for both rproc_ddr and crypto_ddr. UEFI proxy alone does not prove those distinct native requirements.

proxy_lifetime.behavior: PILProxyDxe registers proxy event handlers. Event1 or8 invokes vote; event16 invokes unvote. Event2 may install SSR callback or an EFI relative timer; timer callback completes and destroys clients.
proxy_lifetime.required_strategy: Use independent clients and retained resources, not the stock PIL_ADSP client. Confirm provider shutdown/ExitBootServices treatment before producing a lease.

exit_boot_services.observed: Callback uninstalls RPMh protocol and calls RVA0x39e8. It iterates configured drivers/TCS and invokes0x7ca0 plus0x7d70, each writing zero to per-TCS offsets0xd24 and0xd2c (driver type2 adds0x20000; TCS stride0x2a0).
exit_boot_services.limit: This proves teardown of TCS controls, not that all previously sent active hardware votes are zeroed. It also prevents claiming persistent sleep/wake programming or callable firmware RPMh service after EBS. XNU needs an explicit RSC takeover/restoration contract.

pil_cold_proof.not_cold_proof: Both GetConfig calls return config data only. Internal context live flag at context+0x2c is not an exposed secure hardware query and may omit bootloader/earlier-stage ownership. SCM PIL command7 means supported, not stopped; command9 describes reserved memory.
pil_cold_proof.query_present_but_not_state: PIL+0x20 invokes shutdown by subsystem ID (RVA0x17b4->0x1fc4); absence of own running context returns failure and cannot prove an earlier stage has stopped.
pil_cold_proof.full_adsp_literal: QcomChargerDxeLA has UTF16 FULL_ADSP at0x20720 plus PIL GUID; must audit this consumer before claiming that excluding GLink prevents ADSP boot.
pil_cold_proof.current_source_includes: ../uefi-giulia/Platforms/OnePlus/giuliaPkg/giulia.fdf includes APRIORI.inc and DXE.inc. PIL/PILProxy and QcomChargerDxeLA are enabled in DXE. GLink is commented in DXE but still named in APRIORI line61; APRIORI is an ordering GUID list and does not by itself prove the module is packaged. Inspect final FV to establish actual GLink presence/absence.
pil_cold_proof.required_strategy: An authoritative boot epoch with all potential loaders excluded/audited, or coordinated teardown of all DSP/IPC clients plus checked ADSP+DTB PAS shutdown completion; never derive cold from stale SMP2P zero.

offline_next_steps: Verify the built giulia firmware actually embeds the same provider hashes, not only matching version fields. Establish new independent named NPA clients with pinned ABI and typed, bounded vector storage.
Finish VCS logical-level support and native ICB route/ack audit for both DSP and secure crypto paths, preserving shared floors. Existing extracted stock ADSP proxy alone is not enough.
Implement authoritative UEFI reservation and cold/reset epoch producer, including all earlier loader clients and post-EBS resource persistence or a native XNU RSC restore transaction.

Only set gan lease bits after actual native successful transactions; report partial evidence otherwise. A complete ABI probe can be implemented offline, but actual hardware boot/playback remains unverified without a device.
